scenarios.name: restricted-black-mana-unavailable-without-swamp-or-forest
scenarios.why: Without a land having the Swamp or Forest subtype, only the unrestricted green-producing ability is available.

scenarios.name: restricted-black-mana-available-with-swamp
scenarios.why: A Swamp meets the restriction, so choosing the black-producing ability taps the Verge and adds black mana.
